subject: Proposal: 24-Month Prepay with Seasonal Ramp and Midterm True-Up
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Mills <sarah@clearwavehealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: 24-month prepay idea + seasonal ramp — quick check

Hi Sarah —

Following up from last week's demo: the team asked whether ClearWave would consider a 24-month prepaid commitment in exchange for a deeper blended discount and a structured seasonal ramp (to align with your Q1/Q3 peaks). We have a couple of template structures we can propose:

- Option A: Front-loaded prepay (Year 1 larger, Year 2 floor) with 12% blended discount and a 6-month lookback true-up.
- Option B: Even annual prepay (equal payment at start of each year) with 11% blended discount + usage credits for burst months.
- Option C: Deferred ramp (lower first-year commit, escalator in month 9) with an annual true-up and 14% discount subject to minimums.

Before drafting a formal term sheet, can you confirm:
1) Your preferred billing cadence (annual vs upfront 24-month).
2) Any internal constraints on true-up timing (month 6 vs month 12).
3) Whether procurement would require a PO or a standard P2P form.

If you want, we can draft a single term sheet with 2–3 options and walk it through legal/finance on our side. Attaching a lightweight sketch to accelerate.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min call this week.

Cheers,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_ClearWave_24m_proposal_v1.pdf (PDF, 340KB)]

From: Sarah Mills <sarah@clearwavehealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@clearwavehealth.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -0500
Subject: Re: 24-month prepay idea + seasonal ramp — quick check

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for the clear options. A few quick notes from our side:

- Billing: our finance prefers annual invoicing for commitments that span >12 months (one invoice at each year start).
- True-up: we'd prefer a month-12 true-up rather than month-6 to align with our forecasting cadence.
- Procurement: please expect a P2P form; I'll attach it when I have the right document — procurement@clearwavehealth.com is on copy.

High-level ask from execs: they'd like to see a version that hits closer to a 14–15% first-year effective discount for budget approval. I know that's above typical bands, so understand if it needs approval.

Can you send a term sheet that reflects annual invoices, a month-12 true-up, and a couple of discount breakpoints?

Best,
Sarah
Head of Platform Partnerships, ClearWave Health

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Mills <sarah@clearwavehealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 13:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: 24-month prepay idea + seasonal ramp — quick check

Sarah —

Appreciate the clarity. I've converted Options A–C into a one-page term sheet with annual invoicing and a month-12 true-up. High-level (summary):

- Structure 1 (Preferred): 24-month prepay, invoiced annually (two invoices). Year 1: 14% blended discount off list with a committed minimum of $900k; Year 2: 10% blended discount with a 10% floor. Month-12 true-up where overage credits or refunds are reconciled.
- Structure 2 (Balanced): Equal annual prepay, 12% first-year, 9% second-year, seasonal usage credits (cap at 8% of total).
- Structure 3 (Aggressive): 2-yr upfront full payment, 15% blended discount but requires 15% additional escrow-style minimum and expedited legal SLA.

I've attached the term sheet + a draft SOW. Laura — can you and Vanessa confirm whether 14% year-1 is approvable within our discount bands or if this needs a manager exception? Also tagging Legal for any required contract notes — I can spin up a redline after we confirm structure.

Attachments: Redwood_ClearWave_24m_proposal_v1.pdf; SOW_draft.xlsx

Thanks,
Karthik

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: 24-month prepay idea + seasonal ramp — quick check

Karthik / Vanessa —

Quick internal: 14% in year 1 is beyond our standard AE approval (which caps at ~12% blended for this seat). Two paths:

1) Approve up to 13% as a standard manager exception if the ARR/margin profile meets threshold and we get a 12-month minimum guarantee.
2) >13% requires Sales Director sign-off + finance approval and a brief legal note for the escrow/minimum mechanics (Structure 3 language).

Vanessa — can you run a quick margin simulation (net revenue, GPM impact) for both the 13% and 14% scenarios so we can advise the customer quickly? If procurement will accept annual invoices, that helps cash flow modeling.

If Sarah's team wants an expedited yes, I'm fine taking this to the director for a one-time exception pending finance numbers.

- Laura
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: 24-month prepay idea + seasonal ramp — quick check

Sarah —

We can get very close to the 15% ask on Year 1 with a narrowly scoped concession set:

- Final proposal (summary): 24-month commitment, annual invoices (two payments). Year 1 effective discount 14% (net of seasonal credit assumptions); Year 2 effective discount 10.5%.
- Customer commits to a $1.05M minimum annual floor for Year 1 (this secures the blended math).
- Month-12 true-up: negative credits roll forward into Year 2 (no cash refunds).
- SLA buffer: we include a capped credit pool (0.5% of Year 1 invoice) for availability credits during Year 1 only.

Next steps: if ClearWave confirms the floor and the forward-credit true-up mechanics, I'll have Legal produce a term sheet and redline within 48 hours. I'll also include a ready-to-send term sheet PDF and a DocuSign link.

Attaching updated term sheet PDF for your procurement/legal review: Redwood_CW_term_sheet_v2.pdf

Best,
Karthik
